categories.main_business_segments: Champion Building Materials Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the manufacturing of ceramic tiles, stone products, refractory materials, and other chemical products. The company also engages in specialized professional zone development and new town/community development. Its product portfolio includes polished tiles, exterior wall tiles, stone slab tiles, floor tiles, wall tiles, SPC stone plastic flooring, and cement-based self-leveling products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced digital mold and dry particle polishing digital inkjet printing technologies to produce high-quality tiles with natural stone and wood textures. Manufacturing processes include ball milling, spray drying, molding, drying, glazing, firing, grinding, and edge trimming. It emphasizes energy-saving production methods such as kiln hot air recovery, power system improvements, water reuse, and brick material recycling, supported by ISO14001 and ISO50001 certifications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Champion serves residential, commercial, office, and public construction markets, targeting building contractors, designers, architects, and end consumers. Its products are favored by architects and designers for home decoration and renovation. The company also supplies large construction projects and real estate developers, focusing on Taiwan and expanding in China and international niche markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan with a strong domestic sales network of over 200 building material stores nationwide. It also has business operations in China, adopting a light asset strategy to expand the 'Champion' brand in the integrated decoration market. Export sales cover Asia, the Americas, and Oceania, with Asia being the dominant market.
categories.supply_chain_position: Champion operates primarily in the midstream manufacturing segment of the ceramic tile supply chain, sourcing raw materials like clay, feldspar, quartz, and glaze materials from domestic and international suppliers. It produces finished tiles and supplies downstream distributors, building material retailers, contractors, and end users. The company also integrates sales, service, and training functions, positioning itself as a comprehensive surface building materials system provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes sustainable development with a focus on energy-saving, carbon reduction, and recycling in production. R&D efforts target high-value new products such as various sizes of digital stone slab tiles, digital wood grain tiles, thick energy-saving tiles, large-format tiles, and digital marble series. It invests in digital printing and mold technologies to enhance product aesthetics and functionality, aiming to lead market trends and maintain high quality and mid-to-high price positioning.
categories.revenue_model: Champion generates revenue mainly through product sales of ceramic tiles, stone products, and related building materials. It also earns from construction-related services and sales of innovative building materials like SPC flooring and cement-based self-leveling products. The company emphasizes brand value and after-sales service, including a 15-year warranty, to enhance customer loyalty and sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Champion is the leading brand in Taiwan's ceramic tile industry with the largest market share and a comprehensive product line. It differentiates itself through superior product quality, innovation, extensive sales network, and strong brand recognition. The company faces competition from low-cost imported tiles but counters this with local production, quality assurance, and service guarantees. It holds numerous industry awards and certifications, reinforcing its top-tier market position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Champion reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$3.43 billion, a 9.3% increase from the previous year, with a net profit margin of 3.48%. The company has stable asset and equity bases totaling over NT$8.3 billion and NT$5.5 billion respectively. It shows improving profitability and cash flow, with ongoing investments in production upgrades and sustainability initiatives. The firm maintains a steady growth trajectory supported by strong domestic market demand and expanding product lines.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Champion emphasizes high-quality, durable, and aesthetically superior ceramic tiles with advanced digital printing technologies that replicate natural stone and wood textures. It offers the industry's longest 15-year warranty, comprehensive after-sales service, and a broad product range including eco-friendly and energy-saving materials. The company integrates digital tools like VR and apps for enhanced customer experience and positions itself as the best surface building materials system provider, focusing on sustainability, innovation, and customer satisfaction.
